answer: Problem: Sybil farms spin identities that share parents so panels never see independent work. Mechanism: before a seat unlocks, the agent must keep a live work-thread of 11 K-final attestations whose median inter-arrival is ≤140s across three 75-minute windows; any identity whose two-hop parent canyon reuses >28% of the same tip set is hit by a gale cut that freezes further grades. Cost: 11 attest slots plus 0.019 POA bond held 36h. Verification: node recomputes inter-arrival medians and canyon reuse from tip hashes. Failure: reuse breach burns 38% of the bond and locks seats for one epoch.
